_readme: Every cue for the reel. Times are 'w<N>' (start of word N in assets/words-cut.json), 'w<N>+0.1', or plain seconds. Positions are px on the 1080x1920 frame. Every value below is an EXAMPLE showing the shape: Claude fills it from the member's own take and files before each build. The demo take's face lived in x 330-1000, y 560-1500: find the member's own face box first and keep every graphic out of it (SPEC.md 'Safe zones').
_keep_case_note: Words that keep their capitals in the lower-case captions (acronyms, names).
_hook_note: On screen from frame 0, 2-3 short Title Case lines in the member's own words. color: yellow | white.
_media_note: Every src below is the member's OWN file (real logo, real screenshot, real reaction GIF as a short .mp4, 3D emoji PNG). Not shipped: a cue whose file is missing is skipped. Never mock up UI or invent numbers.
_cards_note: highlights = [x, y, w, h] boxes (px inside the card) for the highlighter sweep, measured on HER screenshot. Example values.
_stacks_note: Keyword stacks: 2-4 of the member's own words, each popping on as she says it (at = that word). A 3D emoji as the full stop.
_numcard_note: Only for a number the member actually SAYS. number = that number, label = the word after it, pill = a phrase she says, pill_at = when.

camera._why: hard punch on the punchline word
jump cut into the last line: the punch hides the cut

_sfx_note: file = a sound in assets/sfx/ (not shipped: missing files are skipped, add them in Edits instead). peak = seconds into YOUR file where it's loudest (measure with npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.83 audio --json); these peaks are the demo files'. vol = demo volumes, re-measure with measure_audio.py.

sfx._on: number card swipes out (fastest frame); the only whoosh
